KindLabs Model: KindEMR Data Only

Michael Whitehouse

Aneuploidy prediction model based on KindEMR data from fresh IVF in autologous eggs, using age at retrieval and other factors

Functions from other published aneuploidy prediction models:

Franasiak et al. 2014: Percent aneuploid = 1,965 − 278.9 * Age + 16.41 * (Age)^2 − 0.4922 * (Age)^3 + 0.007451 * (Age)^4 − 0.000044692 * (Age)^5

McCoy et al. 2015 (Natera data): Log-odds aneuploid = 4.846 - 0.416 * Maternal age + 0.00755 * (Maternal age)^2

franasiak_aneuploidy <- function(age) {
  percent_value <- 1965 -
                   278.9 * age +
                   16.41 * (age^2) -
                   0.4922 * (age^3) +
                   0.007451 * (age^4) -
                   0.000044692 * (age^5)
  return(percent_value / 100) # Convert to proportion (0-1 scale)
}

natera_aneuploidy <- function(age) {
  log_odds_value <- 4.846 - 0.416 * age + 0.00755 * (age^2)
  return(exp(log_odds_value) / (1 + exp(log_odds_value))) # Convert log-odds to probability
}

Predict aneuploidy rate based on patient age at retrieval

kb <- kb |> 
  mutate(patient_age_year_at_retrieval = floor(patient_age_at_retrieval)) |>
  filter(patient_age_year_at_retrieval |> between(15, 50)) |>
  filter(!is.na(pgta_aneuploid))

rates_by_age <- kb |>
  group_by(patient_age_year_at_retrieval) |>
  summarise(
    pgta_euploid_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_euploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_euploid_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_euploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_segmental_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_segmental_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_triploid_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_triploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_triploid_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_triploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_segmental_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_segmental_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_low_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_low), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_low_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_low), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_high_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_high), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_high_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_high), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_dna_detected_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_no_dna_detected), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_dna_detected_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_no_dna_detected), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_result_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_no_result), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_result_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_no_result), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_clinical_results_undetermined_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_clinical_results_undetermined), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_clinical_results_undetermined_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_clinical_results_undetermined), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_inconclusive_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_inconclusive), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_inconclusive_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_inconclusive), na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    distinct_attempts = n_distinct(attempt_id),
    distinct_patients = n_distinct(patient_id)
  ) |> 
  filter(n >= 50)

# date range of biopsies
min_bx_date <- kb |> 
  filter(patient_age_year_at_retrieval %in% rates_by_age$patient_age_year_at_retrieval) |>
  filter(!(bx_date < ymd("2020-01-01"))) |> 
  summarize(min_bx_date = min(bx_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |> pull(min_bx_date)

max_bx_date <- kb |> 
  filter(patient_age_year_at_retrieval %in% rates_by_age$patient_age_year_at_retrieval) |>
  filter(!(bx_date > today())) |> 
  summarize(max_bx_date = max(bx_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |> pull(max_bx_date)

# format bx_date as "Month Year"
bx_date_range <- paste0(format(min_bx_date, "%B %Y"), " to ", format(max_bx_date, "%B %Y"))
g1 <- rates_by_age |> 
  mutate(
    se = sqrt((pgta_aneuploid_rate * (1 - pgta_aneuploid_rate)) / n),
    ymin = pgta_aneuploid_rate - 1.96 * se,
    ymax = pgta_aneuploid_rate + 1.96 * se
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = patient_age_year_at_retrieval, y = pgta_aneuploid_rate)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), width = 0.2, color = "gray50") +
  # geom_smooth (
  #   method = "glm",
  #   method.args = list(family = "binomial"),
  #   formula = y ~ poly(x, 5, raw = TRUE),
  #   aes(weight = n),
  #   # se = TRUE,
  #   # level = 0.95,
  #   color = "#F9E168"
  #   # fill = "#F3E7DA"
  # ) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(), limits = c(0,1))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    title = "KindLabs Aneuploidy Rate by Age",
    subtitle = paste0("Fresh autologous IVF cycles in KindEMR, ", bx_date_range),
    x = "Patient Age at Retrieval (years)",
    y = "",
    caption = glue::glue(rates_by_age_n$n, " trophectoderm biopsies, ", 
                         rates_by_age_n$distinct_attempts, " fresh autologous IVF cycles, ",
                         rates_by_age_n$distinct_patients, " patients"))

# function to fit polynomial of n degree and make same graph above
fit_polynomial <- function(data, degree = 5, caption_text = "5th degree polynomial") {
  data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = patient_age_year_at_retrieval, y = pgta_aneuploid_rate)) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ poly(x, degree, raw = TRUE),
      se = FALSE,
      color = "#F9E168"
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "#353148") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(), limits = c(0,1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "",
      subtitle = caption_text
    )
}
# 5 ggplots together for each polynomial order from 1 to 5
combined_polynomial_plots <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  fit_polynomial(rates_by_age,1, "1st degree polynomial (line)"),
  fit_polynomial(rates_by_age,2, "2nd degree polynomial (parabola)"),
  fit_polynomial(rates_by_age,3, "3rd degree polynomial (cubic)"),
  fit_polynomial(rates_by_age,4, "4th degree polynomial"),
  fit_polynomial(rates_by_age,5, "5th degree polynomial")
  ) + 
  # plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    labs(
      subtitle = "KindLabs Aneuploidy Rate by Age with Polynomial Fits of Varying Degree",
    )
  )

# print model summary table of cubic splines fit with 3 knots
spline_model <- glm(
  pgta_aneuploid_rate ~ splines::ns(patient_age_year_at_retrieval, 5), 
  family = "binomial", 
  weights = n, 
  data = rates_by_age
)

summary(spline_model)

    intercept = TRUE,
    # Map the messy formula string to a clean name
    label = list(

  # Optional: Clean up the numbered rows (1, 2, 3...) if you want them to say "Term 1", etc.

    ~ .x |>

                            paste("Spline Term", row_number() - 1),

  ) +
  annotate(
      "text",
      x = 25,

# The secondary axis labels will then reverse this transformation.
max_n_value <- max(rates_by_age$n, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create the combined plot
combined_plot <- g1_splines +
  geom_col(aes(y = n / max_n_value, fill = "Count of Embryos"), alpha = 0.6) +

  # Define scales
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Patient Age at Retrieval (years)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5) # Adjust n for desired number of breaks
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "PGT-A Aneuploidy Rate",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(), 
    limits = c(0,1),
    
    # Secondary Y-axis for Count of Embryos
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ . * max_n_value, # Inverse transformation to get original 'n' values
      name = "Total Embryos Biopsied",
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
    )
  ) +

  # Manual color and fill scales for legend and appearance
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Count of Embryos" = "#353148",        # Fill for geom_col
      "Aneuploidy Rate (SE)" = "#F3E7DA"     # Fill for geom_smooth SE band
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Aneuploidy Rate (Trend)" = "#F9E168", # Color for geom_smooth line
      "Aneuploidy Rate (Points)" = "#353148" # Color for geom_point
    ),
    # Ensure points are visible in the legend if a line is also present
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
      linetype = c("solid", "blank"), # Line for trend, no line for points
      shape = c(NA, 16)               # No shape for trend, point shape for points
    ))
  ) +

  # Labels and Title
  labs(
    title = "Aneuploidy Rate and Embryo Count by Patient Age",
    subtitle = paste0("Fresh autologous IVF cycles in KindEMR, ", bx_date_range),
    x = "Patient Age at Retrieval (years)"
    # Y-axis labels are set in scale_y_continuous and sec_axis
  ) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
  )

rates_by_bx_day <- kb |>

  summarise(

    pgta_euploid_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_euploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_segmental_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_aneuploid_segmental_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_aneuploid_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_triploid_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_triploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_triploid_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_triploid), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_whole_chromosome), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_segmental_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_segmental_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_segmental), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_low_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_low), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_low_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_low), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_high_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_high), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_mosaic_high_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_mosaic_high), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_dna_detected_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_no_dna_detected), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_dna_detected_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_no_dna_detected), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_result_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_no_result), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_no_result_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_no_result), na.rm = TRUE),

    pgta_clinical_results_undetermined_total = sum(as.numeric(pgta_clinical_results_undetermined), na.rm = TRUE),
    pgta_inconclusive_rate = mean(as.numeric(pgta_inconclusive), na.rm = TRUE),

  )
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by bx_day and patient_age_year_at_retrieval.
## ℹ Output is grouped by bx_day.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
## ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(bx_day, patient_age_year_at_retrieval))` for
##   per-operation grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
g_bx_day <- rates_by_bx_day |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = patient_age_year_at_retrieval, y = pgta_aneuploid_rate)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = bx_day), alpha = 0.6, shape = 21, size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = "binomial"),
    formula = y ~ splines::ns(x, df = 8), # df=8 for natural cubic spline with 5 internal knots
    aes(weight = n, color = bx_day, fill = bx_day), # Map color and fill to bx_day
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    alpha = 0.15 # Adjust alpha for CI band transparency (0.0 to 1.0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Biopsy Day", 
    values = c("#F9E168", "#91b777", "#353148") # Yellow, Green, Dark Purple/Blue
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Biopsy Day", 
    values = c("#F9E168", "#91b777", "#353148") # Same colors for lines
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    title = "KindLabs Aneuploidy Rate by Age and Biopsy Day",
    subtitle = paste0("Fresh autologous IVF cycles in KindEMR, ", bx_date_range),
    x = "Patient Age at Retrieval (years)",
    y = "")


g_bx_day |> add_kb_logo()
